regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and opening text
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate Pd-catalyzed C-S coupling claim. The text mentions an online SI table, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI facts were imported.
Classified the transition-metal-catalyzed propargylic alcohol/sodium sulfinate coupling as prior work; reported C-C branches and unknown C-S branches were not promoted to current-paper experiments.

Classified the propargylic acetate/sodium sulfinate transformation as the generic current reaction class with printed Pd(dmdba)2/DPEphos/DMSO-H2O/Ar/100 °C conditions; specific runs remain in Table 1 and Schemes 2-5.
Mapped entries 1-13, failures, byproduct observations, and the selected condition to the independent Table 1 row records on page 2 without duplicate prose-only records.

unresolved: Scheme 1a/b use generic R groups and do not define unique structures.
The generic Scheme 1b arrow does not print a reaction time or experiment-specific yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 header, entries 1-13, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: All thirteen optimization rows were retained separately with shared/overridden scale, catalyst, DPEphos omission, water omission, solvent volumes, time, Ar/100 °C, NMR yields, trace, dashes, and byproduct 4aa outcomes. Entry 9 preserves the table/prose omission ambiguity.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 2 complete scope grid and caption
regions.finding: All 35 displayed propargylic-acetate scope rows (3aa through 3Ia) were recorded independently with row yield, time, footnote scale/catalyst/solvent overrides, deuterium content, and pharmaceutical-fragment annotations.

Narrative structure assignments, 3ea X-ray statement, 3Aa disulfone description, and limitations were linked to the matching scope rows. Scheme S1 limitations were not imported because SI association is unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 3 and Scheme 4 introduction prose
regions.finding: Mapped sulfinate-scope statements to the eleven Scheme 3 rows on page 3 and the gram-scale/two-step/direct-desilylation applications to Scheme 4 records; no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: Scheme 2 ordinary yield basis, workups, purifications, and masses are not printed.
Compact scope structures remain label-only where safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 3 scope grid and caption
regions.finding: All eleven sodium-sulfinate scope rows were recorded independently with exact yield/time and footnote scale/catalyst overrides.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 4 gram-scale and application arrows/caption
regions.finding: Separated the 4.0 mmol gram-scale reaction, Cu/Grignard C-S functionalization, S-4 desilylation with a 50% two-step yield from 3ya, direct 3ya desilylation, and the two divergent oxidations. Every caption reagent/loading/volume/time is a participant or condition.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right mechanism discussion and lower-right Scheme 5a monitoring
regions.finding: Recorded one time-course experiment with product/intermediate/substrate outcomes at 2.5, 5, and 50 min; graph aliquots were not turned into separate preparations. The 8% versus 'trace' description remains unresolved across pages 3-4.
Retained three distinct isomerization controls: without Pd, without 2a, and with 10 mol% 2a, including no-product, 49%/84% product, and 96%/21% recovery outcomes.
Classified complexes I, I', II, and III and paths 1/2 as a proposed mechanism rather than reported preparations.

unresolved: Scheme 3 and most Scheme 4 outcomes omit yield basis/workup/purification/mass.
Scheme 5 controls omit absolute scale and do not fully restate the standard-condition composition.
The monitoring scale and aliquot details are absent.

regions.finding: Visually inspected the full proposed cycle and retained it as one mechanism record; generic intermediates and alternative paths are not isolated experiments.
The conclusion adds no new reaction. Its 'trace at 2.5 min' wording is linked to the Scheme 5a monitoring record and retained alongside the page-3 8% value as a source wording conflict.

regions.region: page 4 data availability and CCDC statement
regions.finding: The article says SI is available and reports CCDC 2412558 for 3ea. Workspace SI association remains unestablished; the crystal statement was linked to the existing 3ea row without creating a preparation or verifying a machine structure.
The reproduction statement for 3pa, 3Ca, and 3mh was linked as provenance to existing scope records; absent independent run details, no duplicate experiments were created.
Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external cited papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: CCDC 2412558 is crystallographic data, not an explicitly associated workspace SI file.
The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable runs.
The page-4 trace wording and page-3 8% value are both retained.
